```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(nlmixr2lib)
library(PKNCA)
library(rxode2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Model and source

* Citation: `r rxode2::rxode(readModelDb("FernandezAlarcon_2024_tacrolimus"))$reference`
* Description: `r rxode2::rxode(readModelDb("FernandezAlarcon_2024_tacrolimus"))$description`
* Article: [Front Pharmacol 2024;15:1456565](https://doi.org/10.3389/fphar.2024.1456565)

```{r load-model}
mod <- readModelDb("FernandezAlarcon_2024_tacrolimus")
mod_typical <- rxode2::zeroRe(mod)
```

# Population

Fernandez-Alarcon 2024 analysed 1,067 whole-blood tacrolimus concentrations from
138 de novo adult kidney transplant recipients treated at a single Spanish
centre (Hospital Universitari de Bellvitge, Barcelona) between 2012 and 2022.
All received the once-daily extended-release formulation (Advagraf) from 24 h
after transplantation at 0.1 mg/kg/day, titrated to a whole-blood trough of
5-10 ng/mL, together with mycophenolic acid and corticosteroids. Twenty-nine
patients had a full 24-h profile on day 5 post-transplant (pre-dose and 0.5, 1,
2, 4, 8, 12, 20 and 24 h) plus troughs on days 10 and 15; the remaining 109 had
troughs on days 5, 10 and 15.

Baseline characteristics (Table 1, median and range): age 54 years (19-82),
body weight 70.5 kg (44.0-109.0), BMI 25.6 kg/m^2 (17.2-36.2), fat-free mass
51.9 kg (30.5-73.9); 90 male and 48 female. CYP3A5 genotype was `*1/*1` in 3
(2.2%), `*1/*3` in 17 (12.3%) and `*3/*3` in 118 (85.5%) patients; CYP3A4
`*1/*22` in 12 (8.6%). Hematocrit was low early after transplantation and rose
over the study (Table 2): median 29.7% on day 5, 31.3% on day 10 and 32.9% on
day 15 (range 20.9-46.6%).

The same information is available programmatically via the model's
`population` metadata (`readModelDb("FernandezAlarcon_2024_tacrolimus")()$population`).

# Source trace

| Element | Value | Source location |
|---|---|---|
| Structure: 2-compartment, first-order absorption with lag time, linear elimination | -- | Results 3.2; Methods 2.6.1 |
| `lcl` (CL/F, 70-kg CYP3A5*1 carrier, age <= 60 y) | 26.5 L/h | Table 4, theta1 |
| `e_cyp3a5_nonexpr_cl` (CL/F multiplier, CYP3A5*1 non-carrier) | 0.666 | Table 4, theta2 and footnote |
| `e_age_cl` (CL/F decrease per year of age when age > 60 y) | 0.0562 L/h/y | Table 4, theta3; Equation 3 |
| CL/F equation `(theta1 * theta2 - theta3 * AGE * agecat) * (BW/70)^0.75` | -- | Table 4 header row and footnote; Equation 3 |
| `lvc` (Vc/F, 70 kg) | 327 L | Table 4 |
| `lvp` (Vp/F, not scaled) | 298 L | Table 4 |
| `lq` (CLD/F, 70 kg) | 51.9 L/h | Table 4 |
| Allometric exponents 0.75 (CL/F, CLD/F) and 1 (Vc/F), fixed | -- | Table 4 footnote |
| `lka` (Ka, fixed) | 2.0 1/h | Table 4; Results 3.2 |
| `ltlag` (lag time) | 0.341 h | Table 4 |
| F = 1 | -- | Methods 2.6.1 |
| `etalcl` | 32.1% CV | Table 4 |
| `etalvc` | 48.2% CV | Table 4 |
| `propSd` | 28.2% | Table 4; Results 3.2 ("modeled as proportional") |
| Whole-blood concentrations standardized to hematocrit 45% | `Cc = Cstd * HCT / 45` | Methods 2.6.2; Results 3.2 |

# Virtual cohort

Observed data are not public. The cohort below mirrors the Monte Carlo design
of the paper's Figures 3 and 4: 70-kg patients, CYP3A5*1 carriers and
non-carriers, aged 50 years (any age of 60 or younger gives the same CL/F) or
80 years, with hematocrit drawn uniformly within the paper's three bands
(22-29%, 30-39%, 40-49%). Every subject receives 5 mg once daily from time 0;
day 5 of treatment is the fifth dosing interval (96-120 h). Twelve arms of 100
subjects each are simulated. The model is linear in dose, so the exposures at
5.5-7.5 mg in the figure replications are the 5-mg results multiplied by
dose / 5.

```{r cohort}
set.seed(20241004)
rxode2::rxSetSeed(20241004)

n_per_arm <- 100L
dose_mg <- 5
tau <- 24
n_doses <- 5L
t_start <- tau * (n_doses - 1L)
obs_times <- c(seq(t_start, t_start + 2, by = 0.25), seq(t_start + 3, t_start + tau, by = 1))

hct_bands <- tibble::tribble(
  ~hct_band,   ~hct_lo, ~hct_hi,
  "0.22-0.29", 22,      29.9,
  "0.30-0.39", 30,      39.9,
  "0.40-0.49", 40,      49
)

arms <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  CYP3A5_EXPR = c(1, 0),
  AGE = c(50, 80),
  hct_band = hct_bands$hct_band
) |>
  left_join(hct_bands, by = "hct_band") |>
  mutate(
    arm = row_number(),
    genotype = ifelse(CYP3A5_EXPR == 1, "CYP3A5*1 carriers", "CYP3A5*1 non-carriers"),
    age_group = ifelse(AGE > 60, "80 years", "<=60 years")
  )

subjects <- arms |>
  slice(rep(seq_len(n()), each = n_per_arm)) |>
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    WT = 70,
    HCT = runif(n(), hct_lo, hct_hi)
  )

doses <- subjects |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(time = tau * (seq_len(n_doses) - 1L)) |>
  mutate(amt = dose_mg, evid = 1L, cmt = "depot")
obs <- subjects |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(time = obs_times) |>
  mutate(amt = NA_real_, evid = 0L, cmt = "central")
events <- bind_rows(doses, obs) |>
  arrange(id, time, desc(evid)) |>
  select(id, time, amt, evid, cmt, WT, AGE, CYP3A5_EXPR, HCT, arm)

stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(events$id) == nrow(arms) * n_per_arm)
```

# Simulation

```{r simulate}
sim <- rxode2::rxSolve(mod, events = events, keep = "arm") |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  left_join(arms |> select(arm, genotype, age_group, hct_band), by = "arm")

stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(sim$id) == nrow(arms) * n_per_arm)
```

## Typical-value day-5 profiles

```{r typical-profiles, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Typical-value (no between-subject variability) whole-blood profiles over the fifth dosing interval of 5 mg once daily at a hematocrit of 45%, by CYP3A5 genotype and age."}
typ_events <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  CYP3A5_EXPR = c(1, 0),
  AGE = c(50, 80)
) |>
  mutate(id = row_number(), WT = 70, HCT = 45)
typ_ev <- bind_rows(
  typ_events |> tidyr::expand_grid(time = tau * (seq_len(n_doses) - 1L)) |>
    mutate(amt = dose_mg, evid = 1L, cmt = "depot"),
  typ_events |> tidyr::expand_grid(time = obs_times) |>
    mutate(amt = NA_real_, evid = 0L, cmt = "central")
) |>
  arrange(id, time, desc(evid))

sim_typ <- rxode2::rxSolve(mod_typical, events = typ_ev) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(
    genotype = ifelse(CYP3A5_EXPR == 1, "CYP3A5*1 carriers", "CYP3A5*1 non-carriers"),
    age_group = ifelse(AGE > 60, "80 years", "<=60 years")
  )

ggplot(sim_typ, aes(time - t_start, Cc, colour = age_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~genotype) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(5, 10), linetype = "dashed", colour = "blue") +
  labs(
    x = "Time after the day-5 dose (h)",
    y = "Whole-blood tacrolimus (ng/mL)",
    colour = "Age"
  )
```

# PKNCA validation

Exposure on day 5 is computed with PKNCA over the fifth dosing interval. The
treatment grouping variable is the simulated arm (genotype x age x hematocrit
band). `cmin` over that interval is the pre-dose trough of the day-5 dose
(with the 0.34-h lag the concentration keeps falling for a few minutes after
the dose).

```{r pknca}
sim_nca <- sim |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Cc)) |>
  dplyr::select(id, time, Cc, arm)

dose_df <- events |>
  dplyr::filter(evid == 1) |>
  dplyr::select(id, time, amt, arm)

conc_obj <- PKNCA::PKNCAconc(sim_nca, Cc ~ time | arm + id, concu = "ng/mL", timeu = "h")
dose_obj <- PKNCA::PKNCAdose(dose_df, amt ~ time | arm + id, doseu = "mg")
intervals <- data.frame(
  start = t_start,
  end = t_start + tau,
  cmax = TRUE,
  tmax = TRUE,
  cmin = TRUE,
  auclast = TRUE
)
nca_res <- PKNCA::pk.nca(PKNCA::PKNCAdata(conc_obj, dose_obj, intervals = intervals))

nca_ind <- as.data.frame(nca_res$result) |>
  dplyr::select(id, arm, PPTESTCD, PPORRES) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = PPTESTCD, values_from = PPORRES) |>
  left_join(arms |> select(arm, genotype, age_group, hct_band), by = "arm")

stopifnot(nrow(nca_ind) == nrow(arms) * n_per_arm)
```

## Replicate Figure 3 (day-5 trough)

```{r figure-3, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6.5, fig.cap = "Replicates Figure 3 of Fernandez-Alarcon 2024: simulated day-5 Ctrough by once-daily dose, CYP3A5 genotype, age and hematocrit band. Boxes are the 25th-75th percentiles, whiskers the 5th-95th; dashed lines mark the 5-10 ng/mL target range."}
dose_grid <- c(5, 5.5, 6, 6.5, 7, 7.5)
by_dose <- nca_ind |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(dose = dose_grid) |>
  mutate(Ctrough = cmin * dose / dose_mg, AUC24 = auclast * dose / dose_mg)

box_stats <- function(d, var) {
  d |>
    group_by(genotype, age_group, hct_band, dose) |>
    summarise(
      ymin = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.05),
      lower = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.25),
      middle = median(.data[[var]]),
      upper = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.75),
      ymax = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.95),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

ggplot(box_stats(by_dose, "Ctrough"), aes(factor(dose), fill = hct_band)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(ymin = ymin, lower = lower, middle = middle, upper = upper, ymax = ymax),
    stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(5, 10), linetype = "dashed", colour = "blue") +
  facet_grid(genotype ~ age_group) +
  labs(x = "Dose (mg)", y = "Ctrough (ng/mL)", fill = "Hematocrit")
```

## Replicate Figure 4 (day-5 AUC24)

```{r figure-4, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6.5, fig.cap = "Replicates Figure 4 of Fernandez-Alarcon 2024: simulated day-5 AUC24 by once-daily dose, CYP3A5 genotype, age and hematocrit band. Boxes are the 25th-75th percentiles, whiskers the 5th-95th."}
ggplot(box_stats(by_dose, "AUC24"), aes(factor(dose), fill = hct_band)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(ymin = ymin, lower = lower, middle = middle, upper = upper, ymax = ymax),
    stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.8
  ) +
  facet_grid(genotype ~ age_group) +
  labs(x = "Dose (mg)", y = "AUC24 (ng*h/mL)", fill = "Hematocrit")
```

## Comparison against the published simulations

The paper prints no exposure table for its simulations, so the reference values
below are the medians of the 40-49% hematocrit boxes at 5 mg, digitised by the
maintainers from Figures 3 and 4 (reading precision about +/-5%).

```{r nca-compare}
published <- tibble::tribble(
  ~arm_label,                          ~auclast, ~cmin,
  "CYP3A5*1 carriers, <=60 years",     185,      4.5,
  "CYP3A5*1 carriers, 80 years",       215,      5.5,
  "CYP3A5*1 non-carriers, <=60 years", 270,      8.0,
  "CYP3A5*1 non-carriers, 80 years",   355,      10.5
)

high_hct_arms <- arms |>
  filter(hct_band == "0.40-0.49") |>
  mutate(arm_label = paste(genotype, age_group, sep = ", "))

nca_high <- as.data.frame(nca_res$result) |>
  dplyr::filter(arm %in% high_hct_arms$arm) |>
  dplyr::left_join(high_hct_arms |> dplyr::select(arm, arm_label), by = "arm") |>
  dplyr::select(arm_label, PPTESTCD, PPORRES)

cmp <- nlmixr2lib::ncaComparisonTable(
  simulated = nca_high,
  reference = published,
  by = "arm_label",
  params = c("auclast", "cmin"),
  units = c(auclast = "ng*h/mL", cmin = "ng/mL"),
  tolerance_pct = 20
)
knitr::kable(
  dplyr::rename(cmp, "Simulated arm" = arm_label),
  caption = paste(
    "Simulated day-5 exposure at 5 mg once daily, hematocrit 40-49%",
    "(median of 100 virtual subjects per arm) versus medians digitised from",
    "Figures 3 and 4 of Fernandez-Alarcon 2024. * differs from reference by >20%."
  )
)
```

```{r nca-assert}
sim_med <- nca_ind |>
  filter(hct_band == "0.40-0.49") |>
  mutate(arm_label = paste(genotype, age_group, sep = ", ")) |>
  group_by(arm_label) |>
  summarise(auc = median(auclast), ctr = median(cmin), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(published, by = "arm_label")
stopifnot(
  # The age effect is the structurally distinctive part of this model: as
  # printed, CL/F drops by 0.0562 * AGE (not 0.0562 * (AGE - 60)) above 60 y,
  # so 80-year-old non-carriers have ~34% higher exposure than younger ones.
  # A mis-encoded age term moves these medians by well over 15%.
  all(abs(sim_med$auc / sim_med$auclast - 1) < 0.15),
  all(abs(sim_med$ctr / sim_med$cmin - 1) < 0.25)
)
```

## Closed-form check of the clearance equation

At steady state `AUC_tau = F * Dose / (CL/F)` for a linear model; with the
hematocrit standardization the observable whole-blood AUC is multiplied by
`HCT / 45`. A long typical-value simulation is compared with that closed form,
and the closed form is compared with the dose-normalised day-5 AUC24 observed in
the CYP3A5 genotype groups (Table 3), evaluated at the day-5 median hematocrit
of 29.7% (Table 2) and an age of 60 years or younger.

```{r closed-form}
cl_typ <- function(cyp, age, wt = 70) {
  (26.5 * 0.666^(1 - cyp) - 0.0562 * age * (age > 60)) * (wt / 70)^0.75
}
ss_ev <- tidyr::expand_grid(CYP3A5_EXPR = c(1, 0), AGE = c(50, 80)) |>
  mutate(id = row_number(), WT = 70, HCT = 45)
ss_events <- bind_rows(
  ss_ev |> tidyr::expand_grid(time = 24 * 0:29) |>
    mutate(amt = 1, evid = 1L, cmt = "depot"),
  ss_ev |> tidyr::expand_grid(time = seq(24 * 29, 24 * 30, by = 0.05)) |>
    mutate(amt = NA_real_, evid = 0L, cmt = "central")
) |>
  arrange(id, time, desc(evid))
ss_sim <- rxode2::rxSolve(mod_typical, events = ss_events) |>
  as.data.frame()
ss_auc <- ss_sim |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(auc_sim = sum(diff(time) * (head(Cc, -1) + tail(Cc, -1)) / 2)) |>
  left_join(ss_ev, by = "id") |>
  mutate(auc_closed = 1000 / cl_typ(CYP3A5_EXPR, AGE))
# Same parameters on both sides: the difference is accumulation (30 doses) and
# trapezoidal error only.
stopifnot(all(abs(ss_auc$auc_sim / ss_auc$auc_closed - 1) < 0.01))

tibble::tibble(
  genotype = c("CYP3A5*1 carriers", "CYP3A5*1 non-carriers"),
  cl = c(cl_typ(1, 50), cl_typ(0, 50)),
  observed = c(22.43, 38.21)
) |>
  mutate(
    predicted = 1000 / cl * 29.7 / 45,
    pct = round(100 * (predicted / observed - 1), 1)
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    "CYP3A5 group" = genotype,
    "Typical CL/F (L/h)" = cl,
    "Observed AUC24/D, Table 3 (ng*h/mL per mg)" = observed,
    "Predicted SS AUC24/D at HCT 29.7% (ng*h/mL per mg)" = predicted,
    "% difference" = pct
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

The non-carrier prediction is within a few percent of the observed geometric
mean. The carrier prediction is about 11% higher, within the Table 3 95% CI
(15.6-32.2 ng*h/mL per mg), and the observed values come from day 5, before
steady state, in patients of all ages and hematocrits.

# Assumptions and deviations

- **Hematocrit standardization.** The paper states that whole-blood
  concentrations were standardized to a hematocrit of 45% (Methods 2.6.2,
  following Storset 2014) and that hematocrit entered through the residual-error
  block, but it does not print the formula. The packaged model uses the linear
  form of the cited method, observed whole-blood concentration =
  standardized concentration x HCT / 45 (HCT in percent). The authors' own
  simulations support it: in Figure 4 the median AUC24 ratios between the
  hematocrit bands match the ratios of the band midpoints (about 0.57 and 0.78
  of the 40-49% band).
- **Age effect.** Table 4 and Equation 3 both print the age term as
  `theta3 * AGE * agecat`, the whole age multiplied by the above-60 indicator,
  not `theta3 * (AGE - 60) * agecat`. This makes CL/F drop by about 3.4 L/h
  in a step at 60 years. The equation is packaged as printed; the Figure 3 and
  4 simulations agree with it (80-year-old non-carriers about 30% above
  younger ones), whereas the `(AGE - 60)` reading would give only about 7%.
- **Where body weight enters.** The allometric factor multiplies the whole
  bracket `(theta1 * theta2 - theta3 * AGE * agecat)`, as Table 4 prints it.
- **Between-patient variability.** Table 4 gives the variances as CV%; they are
  converted with `omega^2 = log(1 + CV^2)`. Inter-occasion variability on CL/F
  was tested but is not in the final model (Table 4) and is not packaged.
- **Simulation design.** Day 5 is taken as the fifth once-daily dosing
  interval and Ctrough as the pre-dose trough of that dose. The
  paper does not say whether its simulated trough is pre-dose or 24 h after
  the day-5 dose, nor whether residual error was added; the comparison uses
  medians, which residual error does not shift. The reference values are
  digitised from the figures, not tabulated in the paper.
- **No non-paper-derived parameter values.** Every `ini()` value comes from
  Table 4.
